indicator_definition: Serum or plasma retinol-binding protein below the age-specific cut-off, inflammation adjusted
source_named: WHO, Global prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in populations at risk 1995-2005 (WHO Global Database on Vitamin A Deficiency). Bands mild >=2%, moderate >=10%, severe >=20%.
note: VERIFIED 2026-09-01 against the WHO source: these bands are WHO's and are defined for PRESCHOOL CHILDREN. Usable as WHO bands for this cell.

indicator_definition: Serum or plasma retinol-binding protein below cut-off, inflammation adjusted, non-pregnant women
source_named: WHO, Global prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in populations at risk 1995-2005 (WHO Global Database on Vitamin A Deficiency). Bands mild >=2%, moderate >=10%, severe >=20%.
band_authority: WHO bands borrowed from preschool children; NOT WHO-defined for women
note: VERIFIED 2026-09-01: the 2/10/20 bands are WHO's for preschool children. No WHO banding for non-pregnant women was found. Reported as a borrowed convention, not as a WHO standard for this population.

indicator_definition: Iron deficiency by serum ferritin below the age-specific cut-off, inflammation adjusted
source_named: WHO, Iron Deficiency Anaemia: Assessment, Prevention and Control, Table 3 p.17. That table classifies ANAEMIA prevalence estimated from HAEMOGLOBIN or HAEMATOCRIT. It is NOT a classification of iron-deficiency prevalence measured by ferritin.
band_authority: PROJECT CONVENTION; the cited WHO table classifies ANAEMIA by haemoglobin, not iron deficiency by ferritin
note: CORRECTED 2026-09-01. Previously presented as WHO iron-deficiency bands. WHO Table 3 p.17 classifies anaemia prevalence measured by haemoglobin or haematocrit; this cell measures iron deficiency by inflammation-adjusted ferritin. Different biomarker, different condition. No WHO public-health-significance banding for ferritin-based iron deficiency was found. These bands are a project convention and must not be labelled WHO.

indicator_definition: Iron deficiency by serum ferritin below cut-off, inflammation adjusted, non-pregnant women
source_named: WHO, Iron Deficiency Anaemia: Assessment, Prevention and Control, Table 3 p.17. That table classifies ANAEMIA prevalence estimated from HAEMOGLOBIN or HAEMATOCRIT. It is NOT a classification of iron-deficiency prevalence measured by ferritin.
note: CORRECTED 2026-09-01. Same category error as child_iron: WHO anaemia-by-haemoglobin bands applied to ferritin-based iron deficiency. Project convention, not a WHO standard.

indicator_definition: Serum or plasma zinc below the IZiNCG age, sex and time-of-day specific cut-off
source_named: IZiNCG, Indicators of zinc status at the population level (Br J Nutr). Defines ONE threshold: elevated population risk when >20% fall below the age/sex/time-of-day cutoff.
band_authority: IZiNCG for the 20% line ONLY; 10% and 30% are project extensions
note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED 2026-09-01. IZiNCG defines a single elevated-risk threshold at 20%, which band_mild_upper encodes. The 10% and 30% bands have no source and are a project extension. Report the 20% line as IZiNCG; do not present the four-band scale as authoritative.
